title: DGA Awards 2025: Anora's Sean Baker wins top prize while Emilia Perez director gives shock Karla Sofia Gascon shout-out
text:
The director of Anora, Sean Baker, accepted the first prize in the 77th annual awards of Guild of America directors, held at the Beverly Hilton in Beverly Hills on Saturday.
The 53 -year -old Baker’s independent film continued to gain impulse to Oscar, since he won the DGA prize for theatrical feature.
“I feel like the luckiest guy in the world to be able to do the things I knew I wanted to do since I was 5 years old,” he told the crowd while accepting the prize, according to Variety .
Anora stars Mikey Madison as an adult dancer who marries impetuously the son of a Russian oligarch, only for his handlers to go impressive purposes to cancel marriage.
Meanwhile, the director of Emilia Pérez, Jacques Audiard, 72, gave a surprise thanks to the low fire star Karla Sofía Gascon, 52, when she accepted the DGA Medallion for her nomination in the category of main awards.
Audiard thanked ‘his beloved actresses’ despite his recent controversy, such as Gascon offensive tweets, which have been described as Islamophobic and racist, have threatened to derail the hope hopes of the film.
The director of Anora, Sean Baker, 53, accepted the first prize in the 77th annual awards for directors of the America Guild, held at the Beverly Hilton in Beverly Hills on Saturday
Meanwhile, the director of Emilia Pérez, Jacques Audiard, 72, gave a surprise thanks to lead the star Karla Sofía Gascón when she accepted the DGA medallion for her nomination in the category of higher awards
The French filmmaker said, through the translator, “the last word is for my wonderful cast, my dear actresses, Karla, Zoë, Selena, Adriana and Edgar, who is not an actress.”
Gascon’s mention was particularly surprising in the light of his recent interview with Deadline Where he said: “I haven’t talked to her, and I don’t want to.”
On Friday, Gascon promised to remain silent during the rest of the awards season after skeletons from his past, almost so tanking his opportunity to become the first transgender person to win an academy prize.
In an Instagram post, Emilia Pérez’s star wrote: ‘I decided, for the movie, for Jacques, for the cast, for the incredible crew that deserves it, because of the beautiful adventure we all had together, let the work speak In itself, with the hope that my silence allows the film to be appreciated for what it is, a beautiful ode to love and difference.
“I sincerely apologize to all those who have been injured on the road.”
Emilia Pérez, who is also starring Selena Gomez, is a comedy of music crime about a cartel leader (Gascon) in Mexico who suffers a gender transition to escape the law and begin a new life.
It occurs after not even the star of Emilia Pérez Zoe Saldana or the composers of the film mentioned Gascon in their Victoria speeches in the 2025 Critics’ Choice Awards on Friday.
Saldana starred in Gascon in the Netflix movie, and won the Critics’ Choice for the best cast actress, while evil, a song with the voice of Saldana and Gascon, won the best song.

Gascon became controversy last month after their past offensive tweets appeared, and Audiard, as well as Netflix, publicly distanced themselves from the transgender actress.
The controversy surrounding Gascon broke only a few weeks before the Oscars, where Emilia Pérez is prepared for multiple awards, including Karla’s best actress.
Recently, Audiard condemned Gascon and accused her of hurting the cast and Emilia Pérez’s team when refusing to remain silent following her social media scandal.
‘I have not talked to her and I don’t want to. She is in a self -destructive approach in which I can’t interfere, and I really don’t understand why he continues. Why is he damaging herself? Because?’ He said to the deadline.
‘I am thinking about how to hurt others, how they are hurting the crew and all these people who worked so incredibly hard in this film. I am thinking about myself, I am thinking of Zoe (Saldaña) and Selena (Gómez). I just don’t understand why she continues to harm, “he continued.
“I am not getting in touch with her because at this time she needs space to reflect and assume the responsibility of her actions.”
Despite his harsh words, Audiard admitted that he had a great relationship with Gascon until his old publications on social networks came to light.
‘It is very difficult for me to think about the work I did with Karla Sofia. The confidence we share, the exceptional atmosphere we had on the set that was in fact based on trust, ” he said.
‘And when you have that kind of relationship and suddenly you read something that person has said, things that are absolutely hateful and worthy of being hated, of course that relationship is affected. It is as if you fell into a hole. Because what Karla Sofia said is inexcusable.
He also accused the actress of ‘playing the victim’ following the scandal.
Variety has also reported that the image of Gascon has been eliminated from the promotional material of Emilia Pérez, since Netflix changes its approach to focus its campaign around Zoe, who is nominated for the best cast actress.
